reviews.comment:
Excelente atencion. Fui una tarde y ya no quedaban chipas (me las habian recomendado muchisimo y fui especialmente a buscarlas). Lautaro me atendió y me dijo que no quedaban. Pero que si volvía al otro dia el se aseguraría de que hubiera... y cumplio. Llegue al dia siguiente y Caro estaba en la caja y sabia que "un señor" iba a venir a buscarlas... ambos son unos genios, gracias totales por la buena onda y excelente atención.
Ahhhh, si... las chipas valieron la espera... riquisimas es poco, son espectaculares. Las seguiré recomendando

(Translated by Google)
Excellent service. I went one afternoon and they were already out of chipas (they had been highly recommended to me and I went specifically to get them). Lautaro served me and told me they were out. But he said if I came back the next day he would make sure they had some... and he did. I arrived the following day and Caro was at the register and knew that "a gentleman" was coming to pick them up... they are both wonderful, thank you so much for the great attitude and excellent service.

Oh yes... the chipas were worth the wait... delicious is an understatement, they are spectacular. I will continue to recommend them.
